build.name: Build
build.run: set -a && . "$HOME/.config/fazam/build.env" && set +a && NODE_ENV=production npx next build

build.name: Bundle
build.run: B=$(mktemp -d) && cp -a .next/standalone/. "$B/" && rm -rf "$B"/.env* "$B/docs" "$B/graphify-out" "$B/docker-compose.yml" "$B/public" && mkdir -p "$B/.next" && cp -a .next/static "$B/.next/static" && cp -a public "$B/public" && rm -rf "$B/public/uploads" && cp serverdeck.json "$B/" && find . -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -exec rm -rf {} + && cp -a "$B/." . && rm -rf "$B"
